papers.authors: Jeff Duan, Arjun Sharma, Jennifer Cruden, Vansh Tibrewal
papers.evidence: 面向视觉-语言-动作动作生成的自精炼采样
papers.tldr: VLA 常以流式生成建模动作分布，同一状态的不同噪声会带来不同轨迹与结果，现有测试时扩展多依赖大规模候选集成或外部校正器。作者将原本用于视频生成的 Predict-and-Perturb 自细化引入机器人，并针对数据结构差异修改细化过程。在 LIBERO 的 400 个回合上用 SmolVLA 评测，P&P 比原始基线提升 5.3 个百分点，且回合级 P&P 不确定性与任务失败强相关，AUC 达 0.851。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically use flow-based generative modeling to learn a rich, often multimodal, distribution of robot actions. Generating samples from flow-based methods involves iteratively updating random noise, and distinct noise samples from the same state can result in distinct trajectories and task outcomes. Existing test-time scaling methods improve action chunk generation via selection, aggregation, or correction, but commonly require the generation of large ensembles of candidates or the training of an external corrector. We adapt Predict-and-Perturb (P&P), a self-refinement procedure for flow-based models originally used for mode-seeking in video generation, to the robotics domain. We find that applying P&P to VLA models requires modifications to the refinement process used in video generation due to differences in the underlying structure of the data. Across 400 episodes of LIBERO evaluated using SmolVLA, P&P improves upon the stock baseline by 5.3 percentage points. Further, episode-level P\&P uncertainty correlates strongly with task failure (AUC 0.851).

papers.title_en: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
papers.authors: Rongze Tang, Chenyu Zhou, Jianjie Fang, Ziming Liu, Zhaolu Wang, Ziyou Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人协作操作的多智能体世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 多机器人协作操作需要对齐未来交互并区分角色与异构本体，现有分散策略、集中模型和多机器人VLA难以兼顾二者。MAWAM将单智能体世界动作模型沿智能体维度扩展，在共享权重下以统一因果序列和联合自注意力对齐多本体想象未来，并以分层语言、身份编码和本体掩码绑定各流。在MA-Bench七项任务上平均联合成功率82.7%，超最强基线30.7%，并在真实异构机器人团队实现实时闭环协作。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. Through an agent-axis curriculum, MAWAM expands a single-agent WAM along an agent dimension to coordinate teams under shared weights. Within one unified causal sequence, joint self-attention spans all agents to spatiotemporally align their imagined futures, while hierarchical language, identity encodings, and embodiment masks bind each stream to its role, identity, and embodiment. We further formalize multi-agent-necessary manipulation along three axes (why, when, and who) and develop MA-Task Harness, a coding-agent pipeline where mutually constraining generators and evaluators co-evolve customizable simulation-data and evaluation packages. Using this pipeline, we build MA-Bench across all axes with seven tasks, pairing joint success rate with role and collaboration scores for fine-grained analysis. On MA-Bench, MAWAM reaches 82.7% mean joint success, 30.7% above the strongest baseline, and achieves real-time closed-loop collaboration on a real heterogeneous robot team.

papers.title_en: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
papers.evidence: 分析量化后大模型输出头被静音的令牌
papers.tldr: 量化通常只用困惑度和任务准确率评估，但模型被量化后还能否输出某些词并不清楚。作者把“任何隐藏状态都无法让某 token 成为输出层最高分”定义为被静音，并提出可扩展的三重检验来估计量化输出头静音了多少 token。在三个开源模型上，大词表模型 8-bit 已出现静音，1B 模型可达数百个，精度越低越多，小词表模型到 3-bit 才明显。多语言词表中被静音 token 以韩中泰阿拉伯希伯来等非拉丁文字为主，说明这是被平均指标忽略的语言敏感副作用。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vocabulary models it already appears at 8-bit precision, up to a few hundred previously reachable tokens on a 1B-parameter model, and grows as precision drops, while a small-vocabulary model resists until 3 bits. The loss is far from uniform across languages: on a multilingual vocabulary the silenced tokens are overwhelmingly non-Latin (Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic and Hebrew), even though Latin tokens dominate the vocabulary. Silencing is thus a measurable, language-sensitive side effect that standard averages miss, and it should be reported alongside them.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Aditya Makineni, Amitesh Sahoo, Qing Tian
papers.evidence: 面向机载机器人控制的轻量视觉-语言-动作模型与分层动作头
papers.tldr: 轻量VLA需实时板载控制，但缩小主干会削弱推理能力，而思维链、双系统或大主干又带回延迟与内存开销。HR-AH在单次主干前向后的紧凑动作头内维护快慢两个潜在状态，通过嵌套推理循环交换信息，实现分层推理。其22.5M参数头比对比方法小3–4.3倍，在LIBERO达97.0%、CALVIN ABC→D平均链长4.40，且延迟最低。该工作证明小模型也能以低成本获得分层推理并提升精度效率。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

papers.title_en: GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Tianqi Li, Yang Wang, Xin He, Le Zhang, Yun Liu
papers.evidence: 免重训练的后训练量化框架以降低GUI智能体内存占用
papers.tldr: GUI智能体因内存占用大和重复调用模型难以部署到资源受限设备，训练后量化又会损害响应准确率及指令-视觉亲和与局部空间关系。GUI-Q面向W4A16量化，采用任务敏感粒度分配（TSGA）和关系保持对称选择（RPSS）来保持响应与关系。在三个GUI模型上，平均grounding TargetHit较最强4比特配置提升8.04至12.55点，静态峰值GPU内存较BF16降低49.9%至56.2%，打包4比特执行带来1.7至2.8倍模型调用加速。该工作为GUI智能体的低比特部署提供了兼顾精度与关系保持的量化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

papers.title_en: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models
papers.authors: Tianqi Li, Xin He, Xue Geng, Le Zhang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Yun Liu
papers.evidence: 面向世界动作模型部署的训练后量化与执行配置联合选择
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型在决策前需比较大量候选未来并反复读取权重，部署受显存与延迟约束。PTQ4WAM 在内存、延迟和任务评估预算下联合选择逐层量化位宽与执行路径，用校准测量和可选语言模型代理生成候选，并先在 GPU 上分析整模型路径。15 个负载、4 个模型家族上，任务得分中位数为 FP32 的 99.2%，固定 GPU 回放加速 2.36 倍、峰值显存降低 71.5%。
papers.abstract_en: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

papers.title_en: Native Block-Quantized Matrix Multiplication and Explicit K/V Residency with Dual-View Access for LLM Inference on RISC-V Vector Processors
papers.authors: Weiying Wang, Yuanyang Xiang, Zhiwei Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM推理的原生块量化矩阵乘与K/V驻留内核
papers.tldr: 针对RVV以单指令为中心难以表达跨指令LLM推理状态的问题，按数据状态生命周期划分专用边界，提出QBS与AKV并保留RVV可编程性。QBS统一原生块量化格式处理、块遍历、整数计算与有序FP32累加；AKV维护本地K/V驻留并提供对齐计算方向的双视图。RTL评估中投影Compute与Matmul分别获35.68倍和51.34倍几何平均加速，Decode Attention较Tiled RVV获1.45倍。完整设计面积仅增12.65%，投影负载吞吐每面积与能效分别提升46.63倍和19.78倍。
papers.abstract_en: Some key execution states in large language model inference persist across multiple instructions and are difficult to express and exploit within RVV semantics centered on individual operations. We define specialization boundaries according to data-state lifetimes and propose Quantized Block Streams (QBS) and Attention/KV Context (AKV) while preserving RVV programmability. QBS organizes native-block format processing, block traversal, integer computation, and ordered FP32 accumulation into a unified execution process, whereas AKV maintains local K/V residency and supplies operand views aligned with the computation direction while leaving Attention arithmetic on RVV. Cycle-accurate RTL evaluation shows that QBS achieves geometric-mean speedups of 35.68x and 51.34x for projection Compute and Matmul, respectively, while AKV achieves a 1.45x geometric-mean speedup over Tiled RVV for Decode Attention. Compared with the baseline, the complete design increases total area by 12.65%; on the evaluated projection workloads, throughput per area and energy efficiency improve by 46.63x and 19.78x, respectively. Further evaluation demonstrates applicability across multiple block-quantization formats and across models with different Attention organizations.

papers.title_en: MotionServe: Efficient Multi-Robot Serving by Exploiting Robot Execution Slack
papers.authors: Zikang Wen, Yuning Zhang, Dong Yuan
papers.evidence: 在共享GPU上服务多个机器人操作视觉语言动作策略
papers.tldr: 多机器人并发执行VLA策略时，独立GPU成本高，共享GPU推理又受物理执行时限约束。MotionServe利用动作分块留下的执行余量，联合决定观察触发与批处理调度：MotionExec按动作块运动结构触发观测，SlackBatch结合各机器人预算与GPU未完成工作量形成批次。在96机器人共享H200上，相比最低停顿基线，平均每回合停顿降低43.4%和32.6%，成功率提升8.98和2.30个百分点，并大幅降低权重内存。
papers.abstract_en: As robotic arms undertake diverse manipulation tasks, a deployment may need to serve many task-specific vision-language-action (VLA) policies concurrently. Dedicating a GPU to each robot is costly, motivating shared-GPU inference. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) allows compatible policies to share a frozen backbone with lightweight policy-specific adapters, reducing model-weight memory and enabling cross-policy batching. However, robot inference must keep pace with physical execution. With action chunking, robots continue executing buffered actions while awaiting new predictions, and the remaining buffered time provides each robot's execution slack for serving its next request. Once this slack is exhausted, the robot stalls until new actions arrive, interrupting task progress. Observing earlier preserves more slack but can lead to disruptive replanning and lower task success, whereas delaying dispatch to form larger batches can improve GPU efficiency but consumes slack and risks stalls. To balance these competing demands, we present MotionServe, a shared-GPU serving system that coordinates robot observation timing with server-side batch formation. MotionExec selects observation triggers based on motion structure in predicted action chunks, allowing inference to overlap with remaining buffered execution. SlackBatch combines the resulting per-robot execution budgets with estimated outstanding GPU work to determine when to wait, which requests to batch, and when to dispatch them. We evaluate X-VLA on LIBERO and SimplerEnv's WidowX tasks and OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO, with up to 96 simulated robots sharing one NVIDIA H200 GPU. At 96 robots, MotionServe reduces mean stall per episode by 43.4% and 32.6% and improves task success by 8.98 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively, over each model's lowest-stall baseline. Backbone sharing also reduces weight memory for 96 policies by 97.6% and 91.1%.

papers.title_en: RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yiheng Du, Jingqi Tian, Xu Jiang, Jiexuan Zhang, Shuyu Wang, Zecheng Tang, Jian Zhang
papers.evidence: 在视觉-语言-动作模型内部进行循环记忆推理以完成操作
papers.tldr: 长程、依赖历史的机器人操作常需依据已消失的视觉线索行动，核心是让记忆中的证据持续影响下一步动作。RMR在VLA内部加入显式记忆推理：每步先由视觉推断事件，再修正任务状态并把子目标锚定到当前场景以指导动作。跨步传递状态与子目标，使记忆身份和任务进度决定当前目标。RoboMME总体达66.46%，Reference类79.83%，LIBERO-Mem达90.08%。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

papers.title_en: Beyond Which: Where, How, and When in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yunhe Zhang, Long Gao, Yuedong Fu, Gang He, Li Xu, Chang Wu, Songyuheng Gao
papers.evidence: 围绕何处、如何、何时组织VLA感知与动作预测
papers.tldr: 现有VLA模型多依赖VLM特征判断“哪些实体相关”，但精细操作还需知道实体“在哪里”、几何结构“如何”约束交互，以及空间信息“何时”应更重要。为此，W³H-VLA在保留VLM语义实体感知的基础上，引入空间距离感知、几何结构感知与自适应空间几何引导，围绕which、where、how、when组织感知与动作预测。真实环境与仿真基准实验表明其有效且性能更优，为VLA的空间几何感知融合提供了新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically rely on vision-language model (VLM) features as the primary perceptual source for action prediction, showing strong generalization across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. Although VLM features can identify which entities are relevant to action prediction, precise manipulation also requires understanding where task-relevant entities are located within the spatial layout, how their geometric structure constrains physical interaction, and when spatial or geometric information should make a greater contribution to action prediction. To this end, we introduce {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA to organize VLA perception and action prediction around which, where, how, and when. Specifically, {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA retains VLM-based semantic entity perception which and further introduces spatial distance perception where and geometric structure perception how with adaptive spatial-geometric guidance when to enrich the perceptual information available for action prediction. Experiments across real-world settings and simulation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superior performance of {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA.

papers.title_en: ConsisX: Cross-View Consistency Thinking in 3D for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yunhe Zhang, Long Gao, Yuedong Fu, Gang He, Li Xu, Chang Wu, Pengyu Li
papers.evidence: 具备跨视角三维一致性的视觉-语言-动作操作框架
papers.tldr: 多视角VLA模型常依赖2D特征相似度建模跨视角交互，易出现不同实体错误关联与同一实体信息碎片化。ConsisX在共享3D空间引入跨视角空间邻近约束，并用实体一致性组织跨视角局部信息为统一3D实体证据。最终以任务相关3D实体证据条件化动作预测，提升跨视角一致的动作执行。在3个真实操作任务和4个仿真基准上，ConsisX表现有效且具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual perception and language understanding from vision-language models (VLMs) with action prediction for robotic manipulation. Although multi-view observations provide complementary scene information, VLMs model cross-view interactions based on 2D feature similarity, which can lead to physical inconsistency in the form of cross-view incorrect association between distinct entities and cross-view information fragmentation about the same entity. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisX, a novel VLA framework that integrates cross-view association and entity coherence to enable cross-view consistency thinking in 3D for physically consistent robotic manipulation. Specifically, Cross-View Association Modeling (CAM) is proposed to introduce cross-view spatial proximity constraints in a shared 3D space to reduce cross-view incorrect association. Entity Coherence Organization (ECO) is designed to organize cross-view local information into coherent 3D entity evidence, thereby addressing cross-view information fragmentation. Consistent Action Conditioning (CAC) is introduced to condition action prediction on task-relevant 3D entity evidence for cross-view consistent action execution. Experiments on 3 real-world manipulation tasks and 4 simulation benchmarks establish ConsisX as an effective and competitive framework for robotic manipulation.

papers.title_en: OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Rongzheng Yang, Jiaming Guo, Yuxuan Guo, Zihao Zhang, Yunkai Gao, Siming Lan, Shaohui Peng, Rui Zhang, Tianyun Ma, Xing Hu, Yunji Chen
papers.evidence: 面向流式VLA模型的离线强化学习与在线策略生成优化
papers.tldr: 流式视觉-语言-动作模型可复用部署经验，但反复采集物理交互代价高。OVOGO将离线价值学习与流策略生成过程的在线优化分离，用回报锚定排序评论家为生成动作提供组相对价值信号。在RoboTwin 2.0、DexJoCo、LIBERO及真实机器人任务上，它均优于初始VLA和评估的离线适应、价值引导基线。该工作表明离线经验可反复用于价值学习，廉价生成采样可支撑流式VLA后训练。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. OVOGO introduces a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic that combines in-sample distributional value learning with guarded local ranking, improving discrimination among generated actions without assigning them artificial return targets. The frozen critic then provides group-relative value signals for selected-transition optimization of fresh action candidates sampled from the current flow policy. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, DexJoCo, and LIBERO, as well as a real-robot dexterous manipulation task, show that OVOGO improves the initial VLA across all four settings and achieves higher success rates than the evaluated offline adaptation and value-guided baselines. These results suggest that offline robot experience can be repeatedly reused for value learning while inexpensive generative sampling supports policy optimization, providing an effective approach to experience-based post-training of flow-based VLAs.

papers.title_en: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Zien Wang, Yuhao Pan, Yunfeng Fan, Nan Cheng, Xin Xia, Wenchao Xu
papers.evidence: 以显式三维关系接地增强视觉-语言-动作模型的动作生成
papers.tldr: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型对任务相关三维关系及其操作演化建模不足。WeaveVLA用任务条件稀疏图网络编码物体、夹爪与参考物间相对三维关系，并以成对循环边状态跨观测维护空间上下文。学习查询读出关系token，连同原视觉语言上下文调节动作专家，辅以几何重建目标。在LIBERO平均成功率超98%，LIBERO-Plus与真实任务均显著提升。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{WeaveVLA}, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and $π_{0.5}$, achieving over 98\% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9\% to 82.0\% and from 85.7\% to 87.8\%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN D$\rightarrow$D. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6\% to 70.0\% under standard conditions and from 33.3\% to 53.3\% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the $π_{0.5}$ baseline in both settings.

papers.title_en: EmboEagle: An Efficient Agentic Embodied Framework for Long-horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Fan Xu, Zhongtao Wang, Hao Wu, Yitong Zhu, Wenzhuo Ma, Long Li, Zhuohao Li, Zhisheng Chen, Rui Su, Kun Wang, Xian Wu, Wanli Ouyang
papers.evidence: 面向长时程机器人操作的闭环具身框架
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作需跨阶段可靠执行，独立世界-动作模型易累积物理误差，而无状态VLM监督延迟高且缺乏三维空间持续性。EmboEagle提出闭环智能体框架，统一子任务条件WAM控制、潜空间自适应监督与记忆引导几何恢复。在RMBench和LIBERO-Mem上平均成功率分别达91.3%和90.6%，较最强基线提升8.0和9.8个百分点。自适应门控还将VLM调用减少74.2%，兼顾效率与可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic manipulation demands reliable execution across interdependent stages, yet standalone World-Action Models (WAMs) suffer from compounding physical errors, while stateless Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervision incurs prohibitive chunkwise latency and lacks 3D spatial persistence. We present EmboEagle, a closed-loop agentic framework that unifies subtask-conditioned WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided geometric recovery. First, we adapt sequential WAMs via decoupled two-stage flow matching that preserves cross-stage visual history while calibrating truncated action supervision at subtask boundaries. Second, without an auxiliary vision encoder, we distill teacher intervention decisions into a lightweight routing gate driven solely by the WAM Action Expert's pre- and post-chunk latent transitions and subtask embeddings. Third, upon invocation, the VLM decouples diagnostic status from discrete routing actions and executes parameterized recovery primitives grounded in structured memory (initial references, active grasp bindings, and tool traces), followed by mandatory post-repair verification. Across RMBench and LIBERO-Mem, EmboEagle achieves 91.3\% and 90.6\% average success, surpassing the strongest baselines by 8.0 and 9.8 percentage points, while boosting real-world success over VoLoAgent under identical executor weights. Moreover, adaptive gating cuts VLM calls by 74.2\% versus chunkwise monitoring (91.3\% vs. 93.7\% success).

papers.authors: Xiao-Ming Wu, Kang Liao, Yuexiao Ma, Taolin Zhang, Mingqian Zhou, Nuo Chen, Ziming Li, Yihang Luo, Rui Li, Zhonghua Wu, Tianyu Xie, Xiawu Zheng, Zhongang Cai, Zhi Hou, Chen Change Loy
papers.evidence: 将前沿多模态模型作为闭环机器人执行框架中的策略
papers.tldr: 前沿多模态模型可直接作为机器人策略，在闭环系统中根据观测与指令生成动作，但其harness设计原则与性能来源尚不明确。本文提出Embo-Harness框架，系统研究提示、规划、动作执行与工具使用四个环节，提炼出优先利用模型原生视觉推理与工具调用能力的实用配方。在RoboLab-120上取得83.3%成功率，超出最强基线26.2个百分点，并在四项真实操作任务的20次零样本试验中成功15次。该工作既给出构建强harness的实践配方，也阐明空间目标估计比低层关节或轨迹生成更关键。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.

papers.title_en: Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models
papers.authors: Guangting Zheng, Shaoxuan Wang, Yu Yuan, Zhipeng Tang, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang
papers.evidence: 多模态基础模型与 VLA 策略协作以增强机器人控制的空间泛化
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型能从示教学习策略，却难以泛化到物体位置和任务目标变化。系统分析发现失败多源于目标定位与全局空间路由不足，而局部操作能力仍可用。为此提出MFM-VLA选择性协作框架：多模态基础模型负责目标定位与空间引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA保留精细操作，并用动作块级几何描述与扰动恢复数据微调、能力路由器决定是否介入。在多个仿真基准和真实化学任务上显著提升成功率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

papers.title_en: FoveaWAM: Role-Aware 4D World-Action Modeling for Dynamic Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiaqi Yin, Baoyue Zhang, Jiyuan Zhang, Wenxuan Liu, Zhaofei Yu, Yue Deng, Tiejun Huang
papers.evidence: 面向动态机器人操作策略的4D世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 动态操作中，策略须预测动作执行瞬间的场景，但预测耗时会让场景继续演化；场景级预测昂贵，目标中心预测又可能遗漏影响接触的邻近物体。FoveaWAM按角色分配精度：目标用SE(3)轨迹精确建模，环境用稀疏3D流，静态部分依赖当前帧，实现原生4D世界-动作建模。它在单张RTX 5090上仅需15.1 ms，比视频世界-动作基线快约10倍；在OnTimeBench达82.1%成功率，领先最强基线20.8点，并在DOMINO与真机任务领先。
papers.abstract_en: To manipulate a moving object, a policy must predict the scene at the moment its action executes, yet every millisecond spent predicting pushes that moment further away. Scene-level forecasts are computationally expensive, whereas target-centric forecasts can omit nearby objects that affect contact. Our key insight is that what a policy must predict decouples by role: only the target's pose, which determines contact, requires millimeter precision, while the surroundings matter primarily through the clearance they leave and the motion they impart. We present FoveaWAM, a native 4D world-action model that allocates precision according to these roles. Specifically, it models the target's past and future motion as a metric SE(3) trajectory, the surroundings as sparse 3D flow, and relies on the current frame for everything static. This compact representation lets FoveaWAM act in 15.1 ms on one RTX 5090, about 10 times faster than video world-action baselines, leaving substantially less time for the scene to evolve before action execution. To evaluate each policy under its own latency, we introduce OnTimeBench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark in which the scene keeps moving while the policy computes. FoveaWAM reaches 82.1% success on OnTimeBench, 20.8 points above the strongest baseline, and also leads on DOMINO and real-robot tasks. Project page: https://foveawam.github.io/

papers.title_en: LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models
papers.authors: Shaolong Li, Hongze Fu, Joyce Chai, Yinpei Dai
papers.evidence: 用紧凑预测token进行机器人动作解码的潜在世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 现有WAM多需微调大型视频生成器，训练与部署成本高，且策略所需未来表征仍不清晰。LeanWAM借助冻结视频生成器，先用Future Extractor将观测转移压缩为32个预测token，再把世界token蒸馏进轻量策略。仅1.4B参数、无大规模具身预训练，就在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上超越VLA/WAM基线，A100上25.1ms生成动作块。这表明紧凑预测监督可高效迁移视频先验，实现稳健且快速的控制。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) typically adapt large pretrained video generators to jointly predict future observations and robot actions, incurring substantial training and deployment costs. However, it remains unclear which future representations a policy actually needs and how compactly they can be represented. Our probing study shows that complementary future representations can be compressed into a few tokens while retaining most of their action-decoding performance. Motivated by this finding, we introduce LeanWAM, a latent WAM that transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training. In the first stage, a Future Extractor compresses observed transitions into 32 predictive tokens. These tokens condition the frozen generator and are jointly shaped by action, RGB, semantic, and geometric supervision, while a compact readout of the generator's hidden states supplies complementary world tokens. The second stage distills both representations into the policy, which learns to predict them from current observations while generating actions. With 1.4B parameters and no large-scale embodied pretraining, LeanWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin~2.0. It predicts an action chunk in 25.1\,ms on an A100 GPU, 12.3--41.5$\times$ faster than representative WAMs. These results demonstrate that compact predictive supervision can transfer video priors to robust and efficient control.

papers.title_en: Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Jin Yang, Youlin Wang, Ping Wei
papers.evidence: 多模态世界状态表征驱动双臂灵巧操作策略学习
papers.tldr: 双臂灵巧操作需要融合视觉与触觉、力觉、音频等非视觉物理交互线索，但如何有效整合多模态输入用于策略学习仍是难题。作者提出 HiMoDex 两阶段框架：先在大规模同步多模态数据上预训练分层世界状态表示网络，再冻结该网络并用其嵌入条件化共享的世界-动作 Transformer，联合学习动作生成与动作条件下的未来状态预测。在五项真实任务上平均成功率达 78.7%，较最强基线绝对提升 32.0%。该工作验证了分层多模态世界表示与两阶段训练对双臂灵巧操作的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on multimodal inputs that capture visual context and non-visual physical interaction cues for precise and coordinated control. To address the challenge of effectively integrating these modalities for policy learning, we propose HiMoDex, a two-stage framework centered on hierarchical multimodal world-state representations. In Stage 1, we pretrain a hierarchical representation network on the collected dataset of 1.19 million synchronized multimodal time steps. The network integrates visual context with tactile, force-torque, and audio cues into unified world-state embeddings. In Stage 2, we freeze the pretrained network and use its embeddings to condition a shared world-action transformer. The transformer jointly learns action generation and action-conditioned future-state prediction. Experiments across five real-world tasks show that HiMoDex achieves an average success rate of 78.7\%, representing an absolute improvement of 32.0\% over the strongest evaluated baseline. Extensive ablations validate the benefits of hierarchical representation learning and two-stage training. Failure analysis helps explain performance differences across variants. Code, data, and demos will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/.
